name: PEER NETWORKS
notes:
Peer Networks Pvt Ltd (AS138800) builds and operates neutral digital infrastructure in India, spanning access, interconnection, and data center platforms.

We are the operator of Iron Box Data Centers (carrier-neutral colocation facilities) and Peer IX, a neutral peering and interconnection fabric designed for ISPs, content networks, research networks, and enterprises.

Our facilities support colocation, cross-connects, private interconnects, and remote peering, with an emphasis on regional resilience and operational transparency.

AS138800 actively hosts public-interest and internet measurement infrastructure (RIPE Atlas Anchor/Probe, public DNS & NTP, measurement endpoints) and collaborates with academic and non-profit research initiatives.

Portions of our address space may be intentionally dark, intermittently announced, or blackholed (discard/Null0) as part of aggregation strategy, traffic engineering, security controls, or controlled research activity.

IRR (APNIC) and RPKI records are maintained and periodically audited.
